<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Political rhetoric:</strong> BJP leaders have intensified criticism of the Congress party, citing disputes over the Vande Mataram resolution and protests in the capital, while also demanding the resignation of a Karnataka minister over alleged scams.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Economic policy:</strong> The Union government has notified a ₹62,500 crore manufacturing scheme to bolster the domestic mobile industry, even as the Congress party alleges that the E20 fuel policy is driving up sugar and jaggery prices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxQV0RLQ1pLaWJ4UW02MDE1U2I2OTVTWUk4R1Q0VURzVW90VkZQaFFCb1djTVQxbnBkQk9FSDdma2RHZC1hd0dsOUhqY3l3R1RGTU9MLVJSbDNHc25fQm5qNjJTV0lRdFF1Qm1NRzB5VmN0Z1JNa0Zya2J6LTlCY0F2YkxvTTdiYXhXeHc4aXRwdzlJNnNPY0xJbnB1b0xtV1F2aGUycVNsWFZZdUFfamw2d0lZMHZBQQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial transitions:</strong> Justice Sanjay Karol has concluded his three-year tenure at the Supreme Court, while a separate legal plea has been filed seeking the removal of the Bar Council of India chief.</li>
